title: `retry_policy` on a node that calls two subgraphs makes the second one resume into the first one's checkpoint
version: 1.2.14 (commenter verification); issue body lists no langgraph version
observed_behavior: A node with RetryPolicy calls subgraph research, then raises ConnectionError before calling subgraph review. After the retries run out the run is recovered with invoke(None); the recovered run prints RESEARCH instead of REVIEW, i.e. the second subgraph resumes into the first one's checkpoint and never executes.
structure_focus: retry_policy + two subgraph invocations inside one node; checkpoint namespace/subgraph_counter shifts across retry attempts
notes: Open, labels bug/external. The fixture keeps both compiled subgraphs and the failed-then-recovered invoke sequence, which is the structure needed to see namespace reuse. Root cause per issue: run_with_retry does not reset the task scratchpad between attempts, so subgraph_counter keeps counting. Comments explore reset variants and warn that reusing an ordinal is not the same as reusing subgraph identity; a fix must preserve positional identity.
